FILTERS.INFO-FILTERS-TITLE: Filters can help you quickly find the module or tool that best fits your needs. Here's a brief overview of how they work.
FILTERS.INFO-FILTERS:
• Between filters: Filters are combined using "OR" logic. For example, if you use Filter #1 (library = [PyTorch]) and Filter #2 (category = [AI4 tools], tag = [federated learning]), you'll see all modules and tools that meet either condition.

  • Within a filter: Conditions inside a single filter are combined using "AND" logic. For instance, Filter #1 (library = [PyTorch], tag = [federated learning]) will only show results that meet both conditions.

  • Within fields: Options inside a field are treated with "OR" logic. For example, Filter #1 (library = [PyTorch, Keras, Other]) will return results that include any of these libraries.

BATCH.SUBTITLE: Batch options
BATCH.EXPLANATION: Running a deployment in batch mode means that your job will execute as a one-time process. Here, you can define the specific commands that the process should run. Commands can be provided via a script file or by typing the commands directly in the editor. This type of deployment is temporary and will be cleaned on completion, so please include commands to save any outputs in the storage folder.
BATCH.HELP: Add here the commands to run when your deployment is launched. Remember to save any outputs in your storage folder.
